observations: Completed AND exit0 is the sole success predicate. Completed nonzero and failed/interrupted are failure; completed null and running match neither derived outcome.
Exact optional name distinguishes empty string from null; AND predicates filter the existing ordered full scan before positive limit. Default rows and table rendering are unchanged.
CLI validates invalid selection modes before root/input reads. Recent selection scans once, warns all corrupt records and maps second-newest to A, newest to B.
Selected record objects directly construct captured State and full safe run refs. Same-name current paths cannot shadow selections; missing/invalid selected snapshots produce exit2 without fallback.
Explicit inputs, current profile resolution, full summary/fail-on, display filtering and postcomparison redaction retain the existing shared pipeline.

Tests exercise mode errors, duplicate/exact/empty/Unicode labels, status/outcome edge matrix, timestamp order, corruption, CWD shadowing, one-read mutation, capture history and profile overrides, readonly operation and stubbed manifestless Git lookup.

Copied historical manifest/lock fixtures use shutil.copyfile, preserving bytes on Windows. Newly written JSON strings have no hash dependency. Symlink-unavailable platforms explicitly skip only symlink cases.
verification_boundary: Read-only source/test review; no additional product commands executed. Parent owns final local quality and five-project Gate A.
outcome: No blocking regression or contract mismatch found.
